run_createMultiBodyBatch: run the pybullet script to batch create 10240 rigid bodies in a 32x32x10 grid
createVisualShape_GEOM_MESH: create a pybullet visual shape from mesh vertices, normals, uvs, and indices
createMultiBody_batch: create a batch of rigid bodies using createMultiBody with batchPositions and shared shapes
createCollisionShape_GEOM_BOX: create a pybullet collision shape using GEOM_BOX with specified halfExtents
stepSimulation_loop: run a pybullet physics simulation loop with stepSimulation and gravity enabled
